name: @a2ui-labs/react-app
description: The ReactApp component for A2UI renderers: an agent-written React app in the double-iframe sandbox, connected to the surface data model, catalog functions and actions over a postMessage bridge.

scripts.build: yarn copy-shared && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/build-sandbox.mjs
scripts.test: yarn build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && karma start karma.conf.cjs --single-run=true && yarn test:e2e
scripts.test:unit: yarn copy-shared && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && karma start karma.conf.cjs --single-run=true
scripts.test:e2e: yarn workspace @a2ui-labs/react-app-runtime build && tsc -p e2e/tsconfig.json && node e2e/build-fixture.mjs && playwright test
